> be Grant Lee
> born in NYC, raised in SF
> crack engineering at Stanford
> grind in investment banking
> join Optimizely as interim CFO
> scale the company; get acquired
> experience the pain of PowerPoint users

2018
> join ClearBrain as COO
> more last-minute decks, more pain
> scale again; get acquired
> realize: presentations are broken

2020
> moved to London with family
> second child born
> decide to start a company to fix the tedious PowerPoint problem he had faced for years
> move back to SF, start Gamma
> turn a 2-bedroom apartment into HQ

October 2021
> raise $7M seed led by Accel
> hire the best people in the world
> launch Gamma on Product Hunt
> rank #1 on leaderboard
> acquire tens of thousands of users
> still hungry

Late 2022
> ChatGPT drops
> realize: AI changes everything
> rebuild entire product in weeks
> make AI the entry point, not an add-on

March 2023
> launch AI-powered @GammaApp
> SVB crisis hits, entire industry struggles
> almost can't make payroll
> launch anyway
> growth explodes
> 3 million+ users in three months

May 2024
> raise $12M Series A
> reach 20 million users
> rank #16 AI app globally
> Forbes: "Next Billion-Dollar Startup"
> keep building
> ignore VC pressure
> stay capital efficient

Early 2024
> become profitable with $50M ARR
> 50 million+ users
> more cash in the bank than raised
> zero employee attrition

October 2025
> expand beyond presentations
> turn Gamma into a full creative platform
> slide decks, content, documents, sites
> 700K+ new presentations created daily
> 250 million total "gammas" created
> 100K+ paying customers
> still profitable, still lean

Grant Lee, for you ladies and gentlemen.

From a 2-bedroom apartment to 50M+ users

Lee proved that a small, obsessed team armed with AI is enough to outbuild giants.

Grant Lee: How Gamma Built a 100 Million User AI Presentation Company

Despite being one of the most successful AI tools, @GammaApp was not founded as an AI company. Compared with other presentation tool companies, Gamma was building something deeper from day one: building blocks for visual storytelling.

CEO Grant Lee joined a16z's Sarah Wang and Olivia Moore to share how he built Gamma using taste, design-first principles, and an obsession with the first 30 seconds of user experience.

He also explains the decisions that shaped Gamma’s growth playbook: betting on word-of-mouth, crossing the chasm from prosumer to B2B, and hiring “painfully slowly.” The result: one of the world’s most successful AI applications that wasn’t founded as an AI company at all.

1989135282848059820.text:
Gamma CEO Grant Lee says real product market fit beats brute force:

“We said... ‘The moment you land into the product, it has to be great, and it has to be so great that someone that goes through that onboarding is going to tell all their friends.’”

“All of a sudden… we’d go from a few signups a day... and then it just kept going up. And we weren’t doing any sort of marketing. No advertising. It was all sort of organic word of mouth.”

“The temptation would’ve been, ‘Hey, let’s just spend more on ads or spend more on marketing.’”

“I think that would’ve been a trap.”

Watch the excellent interview with @GammaApp CEO @thisisgrantlee on Lenny's Podcast (@lennysan): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3H0ngGU5pbM
